verdict.rationale: Pandoc is programmatic at its core: the scriptable CLI is its main interface (stdin/stdout, flags for every option), it ships a Haskell library alongside the CLI, and it can be compiled with an HTTP server mode. The only UI is a 'limited' online demo, so the programmatic surfaces offer more than the UI does. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement that the library and server mode match the CLI, documentation of the server-mode API, and a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
